data: What is the value of the purple line marked with squares at the third decoder layer in the left graph?

The purple line marked with squares represents the fraction of compute used per layer for the cross-attention sub-network (CA) at a computation budget of p=0.2. The third decoder layer corresponds to the third point on the x-axis in the right graph. The value of this point is approximately 0.8. Therefore, the value of the purple line marked with squares at the third decoder layer is approximately 0.8.
